## desc

Dark mode switch

## comment

\[UI design software vs. coding - Bilibili\] https://b23.tv/e7a99zR

## purpose

Give a switch a day/night appearance.

## behavior

Adds darkmode and hides its label slot; switch CSS draws alternate sky/thumb appearances for checked state.

## caveats

This does not change the application theme. Bind the switch value to the theme controller separately and retain an accessible name.
